title: Hold a licence to use animals for scientific purposes
what: Use animals for scientific purposes only as (or within) a scientific establishment licensed for that use, with animal ethics approval.

sources.title: Animal Welfare Act 2002 (WA)
sources.quote: A person must not use animals for scientific purposes unless — (a) the person is — (i) a scientific establishment that holds; or (ii) a member of staff of, or a student at, a scientific establishment that holds, a licence authorising that use;

administration.who: CEO of the department administering the Animal Welfare Act 2002 (WA)
